concept: HA: Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs behind an ALB
tests: How to raise the availability of a web app on EC2 behind an ALB so it survives the loss of an entire AZ.
expected: Run instances in an Auto Scaling group spanning multiple AZs; the ALB routes traffic to all AZs. Triggers: "single AZ", "survive the loss of an AZ".
why_not: Termination protection — only guards against accidental deletion; a bigger instance doesn't help with AZ failure; a placement group concentrates instances and reduces AZ-failure resilience.
